NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 100

He says that ... She says that ... They say that ...

他/她/他们说……

A picture lesson on reported speech. The page shows 16 small pictures, each with a caption (tired, thirsty, cold, ill, a cold, a headache, an earache, a toothache, a haircut, a licence, an X-ray, some money, wait, catch, repair, sell), and a box of reporting verbs (says, thinks, believes, knows, understands, is afraid, is sorry, is sure) and clause beginnings (is, feels, has got, needs, wants, can, must, will). Students make sentences of the form 'He/She/They + reporting verb + that + clause' to describe each picture. New vocabulary includes licence. Written exercises (in the textbook) cover rewriting sentences as indirect speech and answering questions using indirect speech. Workbook practice covers reporting what people say (direct to indirect speech), filling in the blanks with reflexive pronouns (myself, yourself, himself, herself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves), and answering personal questions with short answers or full sentences. Grammar exercises practise answering 'What does he say?' questions using reported speech, and changing sentences into reported speech according to the example.

100 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Look at the 16 pictures. For each picture, make a sentence of the form:
He/She/They + says/thinks/believes/knows/understands/is afraid/is sorry/is sure + that + clause.

Example: He says that he feels tired.

听录音并回答问题。看这 16 幅图。为每幅图造一个句子，形式为：他/她/他们 + 说/想/相信/知道/理解/害怕/抱歉/确信 + that + 从句。

The 16 pictures show: 1. tired, 2. thirsty, 3. cold, 4. ill, 5. a cold, 6. a headache, 7. an earache, 8. a toothache, 9. a haircut, 10. a licence, 11. an X-ray, 12. some money, 13. wait, 14. catch, 15. repair, 16. sell.

16 幅图分别显示：1. 累，2. 渴，3. 冷，4. 生病，5. 感冒，6. 头痛，7. 耳痛，8. 牙痛，9. 理发，10. 驾照，11. X 光透视，12. 一些钱，13. 等，14. 赶上，15. 修理，16. 卖。

Listen and answer the questions

Look at the 16 pictures. For each picture, make a sentence of the form 'He/She/They + reporting verb + that + clause'. 看这 16 幅图，为每幅图造一个间接引语的句子。

For each picture, make a reported-speech sentence.

New words & expressions 生词和短语

licence /ˈlaɪsns/
n. 执照

Written exercises A — Rewrite these sentences

Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句把下列句子改写成间接引语。

Example:
He is drinking his milk. He says that he is drinking his milk.

Rewrite each sentence as indirect speech, following the printed example.

Written exercises B — Answer these questions

Answer these questions. 模仿例句用间接引语回答以下问题。

Examples:
What's the matter with him? (feel/tired) → He says that he feels tired.
What do they want? (some/money) → They say that they want some money.

Answer each question using indirect speech, following the printed examples.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A — What does he say?

Report what these people say, think, know, etc. — like the example. 模仿例句将直接引语改写成间接引语。

Example (item 1):
He says: 'I feel cold.' → He says that he feels cold.

Report what these people say, think, know, etc. — like the example.

10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 100 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

B — Structure: Fill in the blanks with reflexive pronouns

Fill in the blanks with myself, yourself, himself, ourselves, etc. 用反身代词填空。

Fill in each blank with the correct reflexive pronoun.

8 items. All answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 100 key (img/key-095-100.jpg).

C — About you

Answer these questions with short answers or full sentences. 用简短形式或完整的句子回答问题。

Answer these personal questions with short answers or full sentences.

4 open-ended items. Suggested model answers are provided.

03

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATION

Grammar 语法练习

I. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。

Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。

Example (item 1):
What does he say? ("I have a bad toothache.")
He says that he has a bad toothache.

Answer each 'What does he say?' question using the direct-speech cue in parentheses, rewriting it as indirect speech.

10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 100 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 530-531).

II. Change the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。

Change the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句改写下列句子。

Example (item 1):
Ann: I can swim very well in the sea.
Ann says that she can swim very well in the sea.

Change each direct-speech sentence into indirect speech, following the printed example.

10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 100 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 531).
